content.comment_body: Looking for suggestions on this application: We have a temperature input, and typically, the analog signal is sent proportionally to the analog output. However, when the temperature reaches a specific threshold (100°), a constant value should be sent to the analog output. Any advice for someone new to [product_name]?

Hello, You might consider using an analog comparator to check if the analog input reaches the desired value. When it does, you can apply an analog multiplexer to assign a set value to the analog output instead. Is this the kind of solution you are looking for? Best regards, [user_name]
Thank you, That suggestion sounds workable; I will try it out today.

analysis.insight_summary: The user seeks advice on setting up conditional analog output in a [company_name] [product_name], aiming for the output to track the input normally and switch to a fixed value once a threshold is reached. Suggested strategies include using built-in analog comparator and multiplexer functions, and the user views this approach as suitable.
